audience: farmers and agronomists who read FieldClimate weather stations and farm records

useCases.title: Read recent station data for the last week
useCases.text: List the stations of the account. Check the data range of one station, then read its measurements for the last 7 days.

useCases.title: Read station data for a set period
useCases.text: List the sensors of a station to see their units. Read the station data between two unix timestamps in one data group. The vendor limits how far back the history goes.

useCases.title: Review farms, fields and crop zones
useCases.text: List the farms of the account, then the fields of one farm. Open a crop zone to see its crop, dates and soil data.

useCases.title: Look up sensor codes and crop names
useCases.text: Read the sensor catalogue for sensor codes and units. Read the list of crops that FieldClimate uses for crop zones.
